name: Villablanca (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of light blue, white and green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villablanca (castles and lions and a tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Villablanca; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villablanca arms — castles, lions and tree on white
castles and crown of the arms
